evidence.title: New Orleans City Planning Commission postpones vote on data center recommendations
evidence.supports: Confirms the interim citywide data-center permitting hold adopted 2026-01-28 (Motion No. M-26-63) remains the operative instrument as of the Commission's deferral of the permanent-regulation vote to October 2026, and that Charter Section 3-126 permits one 180-day extension of the one-year interim zoning district.

decisions.notes: DURATION_MISMATCH: duration_days=365 already correctly reflects the ORIGINAL adopted term ('One year from adoption'). The 180-day figure in the duration text describes a possible FUTURE extension under City Charter Section 3-126 that has not been exercised (the City Council has taken no final action on either zoning docket as of 2026-09-23), so it is not an earlier instrument or a mismatch -- the typed value is left unchanged.
